title: Act of Union (1707)
key_facts: Pair of parliamentary acts uniting the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland into the Kingdom of Great Britain
Created a single Parliament of Great Britain at Westminster
Guaranteed key Scottish institutions (law, church, education) while integrating finance and trade
causes: Succession and security concerns after the Glorious Revolution and Act of Settlement (1701)
Economic incentives including access to English colonial trade and compensation (Equivalent)
Political bargaining among English and Scottish elites
outcome: Formation of the Kingdom of Great Britain (1707)
Integrated fiscal and commercial policy under one state
Framework for British state formation and imperial expansion

figures.name: Queen Anne
figures.role: Monarch at the time of union

impacts: Established Great Britain as a unified political entity
Accelerated integration of markets and military capacity
Set stage for later Acts of Union (1800) and British Empire growth
